_comment: Onigirazu Security Policy Configuration - CONFIGURE ON CONTROL MACHINE
_description: This file controls what file operations, commands, and connections are allowed when running Onigirazu playbooks. Place on the CONTROL MACHINE (where you run 'onigirazu' command) in one of these locations: /etc/onigirazu/security-policy.json or ./security-policy.json
_allowed_hosts_description: CIDR notation (192.168.1.0/24), wildcards (192.168.1.*), FQDN (server.example.com), or regex patterns. Empty array = allow all.
_allowed_ports_description: Network ports allowed for connections. Empty array = allow all.
_blocked_ports_description: Explicitly block certain ports (telnet, ftp, tftp, etc.)
_allowed_directories_description: IMPORTANT FOR filetest.yml: File operations are ONLY allowed in these directories. Default: ["/tmp", "/var/tmp", "/home", "/opt"]. Add /tmp/onigirazu_stress_test to allowed_directories to fix 'path is not in allowed directories' error, OR use a directory that's already allowed like /tmp (which creates /tmp/onigirazu_stress_test subdirectory)
_blocked_directories_description: These directories are always protected. Blocks take precedence over allows.
_allowed_modules_description: Empty array [] = allow all modules. List only allowed module names to restrict.
_blocked_commands_description: Command patterns are blocked. Supports wildcards (*) and regex patterns. Protects against dangerous commands.
_allowed_file_types_description: File extensions allowed for operations. Empty array = allow all file types.
_max_file_size_description: Maximum file size in bytes. Sizes: 1MB=1048576, 10MB=10485760, 100MB=104857600, 1GB=1073741824
_require_encryption_description: Require all file transfers to be encrypted (SSH provides encryption by default)
_max_retries_description: Maximum number of retries for operations
_log_level_description: Audit log level: error, warn, info, debug
